feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1047 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Barbershop Chair Profit Calculator — Haircut Price, Booth Rent vs Commission

Runs in your browser.
